capabilities: store snippets under markdown headings across multiple files, folders, and tags
copy snippets to the clipboard or paste them at the cursor
process snippets containing Templater syntax before insertion
generate an Alfred-compatible JSON file for Alfred workflows
disambiguation: Not limited to code snippets; it also stores everyday text like addresses, passport numbers, and email signatures.
extras: Alfred support requires downloading a separate Alfred workflow and pointing it at the generated alfred-snippets.json file path shown in the settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store and quickly insert reusable text snippets, and desktop text-expansion apps do not work on mobile.
summary: Text-expansion manager that stores reusable snippets in markdown files or tagged notes and inserts or copies them through a fuzzy search modal.
